card.name: Letter Y inside brand names
card.fires_on: The single letter Y partway through a capitalized brand name, usually right after R, A, V or CM, as in RYBREVANT, AYVAKIT, RYDAPT, RYALTRIS and VYVGART. It also fires on the Y in CMYK.
